scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:lite: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,knowledge,reminders -c cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run worker:knowledge" "npm run worker:reminders"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @dubai-ai/db && npm run build --workspace @dubai-ai/api && npm run build --workspace @dubai-ai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @dubai-ai/db && npm run typecheck --workspace @dubai-ai/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @dubai-ai/web
